name: Anchored Hearts: A Tale of Destiny
source:
As Nova, the once celebrated and now infamous pirate known as 'La Belladonna', you are wrongfully accused of a crime. Someone out there is sinking ships, and the whole world thinks it's [i]you[/i]... so the only way to clear your name is to unmask the [i]real culprit[/i]. This is not easy as a fugitive on the run!

Thankfully you are not alone...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2396660/Anchored_Hearts_A_Tale_of_Destiny/]Steam[/url]]
